nationalOverlay.caveat: This is the national SEC/IARD roster overlay for firms that report a New York principal office on the reconciled 23,622-firm geography table (NY = 3,152). It is not the New York state-registered adviser universe, not a federal-covered notice-filing count, and not proof of current New York OAG Investor Protection Bureau authority. NEW YORK PRINCIPAL OFFICE != NEW YORK STATE REGISTRATION. These 3,152 firms already exist in the federal graph and are not net-new organizations. A raw compilation MainAddr=@State=NY count is a different extract and is not this overlay.

riaEra.caveat: National roster keeps RIA (17,018) and ERA (6,604) separate. Committed geography is on the combined roster. New York principal-office counts are not an RIA-only or ERA-only state denominator. ERA is not an RIA. SEC RIA is not a New York state RIA.

oagFramework.regulator: Office of the New York Attorney General, Investor Protection Bureau
oagFramework.clientThresholdNote: Official OAG FAQ: registration or notice filing is generally required when an investment adviser or solicitor has six or more New York clients, with exemptions and separate federally covered adviser treatment. This is regulatory context, not a determination that any particular firm is currently authorized. Do not infer a firm’s New York authority from address, principal office, guessed client counts, Form ADV marketing text, or name match.

enforcement.identityBar: EXACT_FIRM_CRD, EXACT_PERSON_CRD for person grain only, or exact source-native OAG matter identifier
enforcement.caveat: OAG Investor Protection Bureau handles a broad range of securities and investment matters (broker-dealers, investment advisers, issuers, crypto businesses, individuals, fraud schemes, and other securities actors). The public library is mixed-bureau, press-release and document oriented, not a clean IA enforcement census. No bounded OAG regulatory-activity dataset was acquired. Complete OAG regulatory-activity count is UNKNOWN, not zero. Missing census is not zero enforcement activity. This ticket attached zero exact CRD records and downloaded zero PDFs; those are execution counts, not an OAG action census. Name-only attachment is unsafe. OAG action is not an investment-adviser disciplinary census. Case is not a criminal conviction. Action count is not quality. No action found is not a clean record.

complaints.caveat: OAG complaint intake is a public research path. Complaint is not a violation. Investigation is not a finding. Do not answer firm-specific complaint questions with statewide OAG activity.
